preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000, inclusive.
The length of the permutation is between 2 and 200,000, inclusive.
Each element in the permutation is between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all permutations does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer.
The output is less than or equal to the length of the permutation.

postconditions.expression: exists permutation p such that number_of_inversions(p) == 1
postconditions.description: There exists a permutation that can be obtained with the given number of operations that has exactly one inversion.
